description.value: A family-owned estate winery in the heart of West Kelowna's wine country, housed in an architecturally award-winning building with a year-round art gallery. The on-site restaurant 31 Charkay serves contemporary Canadian cuisine with vineyard views, making it a rewarding stop along Boucherie Road for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine routes.
